title: Moose Hygienist
premise: The patient is a moose. The dentist is a woodpecker. The antlers are already through the ceiling tiles. Both of them are acting like this is a cleaning.
visual: Dental office, too small. Moose crammed in the chair, antlers punched through two ceiling tiles with dust raining. Woodpecker in a tiny white coat, goggles, drill like a jackhammer, tapping a tooth professionally. Beaver receptionist in the window giving a thumbs-up. Tray of comically small tools.
characterLean: Workplace professionalism as the gag. No series faces. The beaver is the only one who knows this happens every Tuesday.
grokImaginePrompt: 2D hand-drawn cel animation frame in early-1990s Warner Bros. television cartoon style, NOT photoreal, NOT 3D, 4:3: a too-small dental office, a huge cartoon moose crammed into a dental chair with its enormous antlers punched up through two ceiling tiles and plaster dust raining down, a woodpecker dentist in a tiny white coat and goggles holding a drill the size of a jackhammer tapping one front tooth very professionally, a beaver receptionist visible through the window giving a thumbs-up, a tray of comically tiny dental tools, a hanging lamp, thick confident black ink outlines with slight taper, flat saturated cel color fills with one hard-edged shadow tone and no gradients on the characters, painted gouache clinic, faint cel dust, hand-drawn cartoon, Grok Imagine style
motion: 6-second lockoff. The woodpecker drills one burst. A third ceiling tile cracks. The moose's eye twitches; the smile stays a polite grimace. Dust puffs. The beaver flips a magazine. No screaming. No tooth flying out of frame.
notes: Antlers through the ceiling is the thumbnail. If the moose is panicking it becomes a pain gag; keep it a scheduling gag. No readable clinic name on the window. Distinct from Pin Cat — nobody here is being used as equipment; they just do not fit.
